tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately on a clean transparent watch glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the in-house visual specification.

details.requirement: Inhouse Specification: Fine Brown powder with characteristic odor and taste (spec sheet: Brown powder with characteristic odor and taste; see openQuestions)

tests.source: Horsetail Extract__STM for Marine Horsetail Extract 1-1.txt:30

tests.procedure: Loss on drying (USP <731>): weigh an empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C for about 30 min and cooled in a desiccator (W1); tare; weigh accurately 1.000 g sample (W2); dry in a calibrated oven at 105 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W3); repeat to constant weight. % loss on drying = (W1 + W2 - W3) / W2 x 100.

details.drying: calibrated oven 105 °C, 2 h, then to constant weight

tests.source: Horsetail Extract__STM for Marine Horsetail Extract 1-1.txt:32

tests.procedure: Bulk density: weigh an empty dry cylinder, set the balance to zero, put 10 mL of the powder into the cylinder and weigh. Bulk density (g/mL) = weight of sample / volume (10 mL).

details.stmSpecification: 0.40 to 0.65 g/ml (STM); spec sheet 0.45 to 0.65 g/ml, loaded

tests.source: Horsetail Extract__STM for Marine Horsetail Extract 1-1.txt:31

tests.procedure: Acid insoluble ash (main method as written): 1 g sample with 25 mL dilute hydrochloric acid (W1), cover and heat on a water-bath 10 min, cool, filter, wash the filter paper until free from acid, return to the dish, dry at 100 ± 2 °C about 3 h, ignite at 550 ± 10 °C for 1 h, cool and weigh (W2), reheat at 550 ± 10 °C for 30 min, cool and weigh (W3). Acid insoluble ash (%) = ((W3 - W2) - W4) / W1 x 100, W4 = silica in the sample (silica assay from COA x W2 / 100).

details.acid: 25 mL dilute hydrochloric acid (20 g HCl to 100 mL water)
details.silicaCorrection: W4 = silica assay from supplier COA x W2 / 100; spec sheet silica assay 7.0 to 10.0 %
details.alternativeMethod: USP acid-insoluble ash (crucible ignited at 675 ± 25 °C, 1 g, boil with 25 mL 3 N HCl) is listed after 'or' in the STM and is not transcribed (main method only)

tests.source: Horsetail Extract__STM for Marine Horsetail Extract 1-1.txt:33

tests.procedure: Heavy metals limit test (in-house): weigh 1 g, moisten with sulfuric acid, char, add a few drops of nitric acid and heat to 500 °C; cool, add 4 mL hydrochloric acid, evaporate to dryness, moisten residue with 10 mL hydrochloric acid, digest 2 min, neutralise with ammonia solution and make just acid with acetic acid. Standard: 2 mL lead standard solution (10 ppm) diluted to 25 mL. Adjust test and standard to pH 3-4 with about 2 mL pH 3.5 acetate buffer, dilute to 35 mL, add 10 mL sodium sulfide solution (or 1.2 mL thioacetamide reagent), dilute to 50 mL, stand 5 min, view downwards over a white surface. Brown colour of the test is not more intense than the reference.

details.standard: 2 mL lead standard solution (10 ppm Pb) diluted to 25 mL
details.sulfideReagent: 10 mL sodium sulfide solution, or 1.2 mL thioacetamide reagent
details.reference: In-house specification; Supplier COA for Horsetail Extract 07-10%
